workspaces.Name: Design
workspaces.Tip: Solid, surface, freeform, NURBS and sheet metal modeling.

workspaces.Name: ECAD
workspaces.Tip: Electronic boards, component envelopes and enclosure integration.

workspaces.Name: Scan
workspaces.Tip: Meshes and reverse engineering. Print preparation is in CAM.

workspaces.Name: CAE
workspaces.Tip: Static structures, thermal conduction, natural frequencies, mechanism kinematics and motion, and pipe-flow calculations.

workspaces.Name: Assemble
workspaces.Tip: Bottom-up assemblies: insert parts, joint them, test the motion and animate it.

workspaces.Name: Render
workspaces.Tip: Make realistic pictures: lighting, background and quality.

workspaces.Name: CAM
workspaces.Tip: CNC machining and stock review, FDM preparation and resin cavity checks. Export to your preferred slicer.

workspaces.Name: Script
workspaces.Tip: Write Python that builds and changes models. The editor sits beside the model; everything a script makes is one undo step.

tools.label: Home
tools.description: The home screen: your workspace folder, recent parts, new part.

tools.label: New
tools.description: Start an empty document.

tools.label: Open
tools.description: Open an Prism or STEP file.

tools.label: Save
tools.description: Save the document.

tools.label: Save As
tools.description: Save under a new name.

tools.label: Import File
tools.description: Bring in a file by its type: STEP, IGES, BREP, DXF (as a sketch), STL, OBJ, PLY or 3MF.

tools.label: Import STEP
tools.description: Bring a STEP (.step/.stp) model into the document.

tools.label: Import Mesh
tools.description: Bring in a scan or print file: STL, OBJ, PLY or 3MF.

tools.label: Export STEP
tools.description: Write all visible objects as a STEP file.

tools.label: Export IGES
tools.description: Write all visible solids and surfaces as an IGES file (.iges).

tools.label: Export BREP
tools.description: Write the exact geometry as an Open CASCADE BREP file.

tools.label: Export glTF
tools.description: Write a binary glTF (.glb) for viewers, games and the web: Y-up, metres, one colour per body. Exports the selection, or everything if nothing is selected.

tools.label: Export DXF
tools.description: Write the selected sketches (or every visible one) as a DXF of lines, circles and arcs, for laser, waterjet and CNC.

tools.label: Export 3MF
tools.description: Write a 3MF file for printing: keeps each body separate, in millimetres. Exports the selection, or everything if nothing is selected.

tools.label: Export STL
tools.description: Write a triangle mesh (STL). Exports the selection, or everything if nothing is selected.

tools.label: Export OBJ
tools.description: Write a Wavefront OBJ mesh.

tools.label: Export PLY
tools.description: Write a PLY mesh.

tools.label: Edit Freeform
tools.description: Select vertices, edges or faces and move them with the manipulator.

tools.label: Extrude
tools.description: Extrude the selected faces (or open edges), then drag the arrows.

tools.label: Slide
tools.description: Move the selected edge loop along its neighbouring edges without changing the shape much. The amount is in the panel.

tools.label: Subdivide
tools.description: Split the selected faces into smaller faces, or every face when none are selected.

tools.label: Chamfer
tools.description: Cut a flat bevel along the selected inner edges. The width is 'Bevel width' in the panel.

tools.label: Delete
tools.description: Delete the selected faces, edges or points.

tools.label: Merge faces
tools.description: Join the selected touching faces into one.

tools.label: Collapse
tools.description: Shrink the selected edges to single points.

tools.label: Split face
tools.description: Cut a face in two between two selected corners.

tools.label: Bevel
tools.description: Add support loops beside the selected edges to tighten them.

tools.label: Smooth
tools.description: Relax the selected points toward their neighbours.

tools.label: Flatten
tools.description: Press the selected points onto a plane.

tools.label: Fill holes
tools.description: Cap open borders with faces.

tools.label: Thicken
tools.description: Give the cage wall thickness (Bevel width).

tools.label: Insert Edge
tools.description: Click an edge to add an edge loop across it. The tool stays on for more clicks until you press Esc or pick another tool. Count and position are in the panel.

tools.label: Inset
tools.description: Shrink the selected faces into a smaller face with a ring of new faces around it. Amount, depth and 'each face on its own' are in the panel.

tools.label: Select Loop
tools.description: Select a whole edge loop or edge ring from the selected edge. Choose Loop (end to end) or Ring (parallel across quads) under 'Edge selection' in the panel; Alt+L and Alt+R pick directly.

tools.label: Bridge
tools.description: Join two selected groups of open edges with a strip of faces.

tools.label: Freeze
tools.description: Lock the selected faces, edges or points so they cannot move (shown in blue).

tools.label: Unfreeze
tools.description: Release the selected points.

tools.label: Align to Curve
tools.description: Pull the selected points (or all) onto a curve: pick it in 'Curve to align to'.

tools.label: Smooth surface
tools.description: Switch between the smoothed surface and the plain cage faces. Levels are under Smoothness in the panel.

tools.label: Weld
tools.description: Merge the selected vertices into one.

tools.label: Crease
tools.description: Make the selected edges sharp.

tools.label: Merge edges
tools.description: Remove the selected inner edges, joining the faces on either side.

tools.label: Unweld edges
tools.description: Split the form along the selected edges so each side can move on its own.

tools.label: Pull
tools.description: Pull the selected points (or all) onto the smooth surface the cage produces.

tools.label: Flip normals
tools.description: Reverse which side of the form is the outside.

tools.label: Mirror and weld
tools.description: Reflect the form across a plane and join the halves at the seam.

tools.label: Convert fewer faces
tools.description: Like Convert to NURBS, but each irregular face becomes one fitted patch instead of four: a lighter solid that is quicker for booleans and fillets, a little less exact near poles.

tools.label: Convert to NURBS
tools.description: Turn the selected form into exact NURBS surfaces / a solid for CAD operations.

tools.description: Edit existing faces, holes and bosses: move every picked face along its own normal by a distance; neighbours extend or trim.

tools.description: Edit existing faces so they take the source face's plane, cylinder radius or cone angle.

tools.label: Draft
tools.description: Edit existing walls: lean them away from a pull direction.

tools.label: Split Face
tools.description: Edit existing geometry: divide a face in two along a plane, edge or sketch; the shape stays the same.

tools.label: Merge Faces
tools.description: Edit existing geometry: join neighbouring faces on the same surface into one.

tools.label: Delete Face
tools.description: Remove an existing hole, fillet, pocket or boss and let the neighbouring faces close the gap. Can include matching features or the whole pattern.

tools.label: Edit Feature
tools.description: Edit an existing hole, slot, pocket, boss or fillet: move, copy, resize or delete it. One click picks the whole feature; Select by can take every feature of the same size or the whole pattern.

tools.label: Edit Pattern
tools.description: Edit an existing line, grid or circle of holes, slots, pockets or bosses: change the spacing or count, or drop one instance.

tools.label: Mirror Feature
tools.description: Edit an existing part by copying holes, slots, pockets or bosses across a plane or flat face.

tools.label: Remove Fillets
tools.description: Edit existing geometry: remove fillets and rounds (picked chains or all up to a radius) and let the neighbours close the gap.

tools.label: Edit Freeform
tools.description: Freeform bodies are shaped by their cage: pick faces, edges or points and extrude, inset, delete or move them.

tools.label: Move Body
tools.description: Move or turn a body while keeping a face flush, two holes coaxial or a round face tangent to another body.

tools.description: Check an imported body for open edges, tiny or sliver faces, duplicates and bad edges, then heal, sew or clean it up.

tools.description: Stop serving the AR page to phones.

tools.label: Render Image
tools.description: Make a realistic picture of what is on screen: soft shadows, reflections, studio or sky light. Built in, nothing to install.

tools.label: Render Animation
tools.description: Render an animation (joint motion, exploded view) and/or a camera turntable as pictures, a GIF and, with ffmpeg installed, an MP4.

tools.label: Save Picture
tools.description: Save the last render as a PNG in Documents\Prism\Renders.

tools.label: Close Picture
tools.description: Hide the rendered picture and return to the model.

tools.label: Sun
tools.description: Drop in a global sun: direction, illuminance in lux and colour temperature. Drag it in the viewport.

tools.label: Lamp
tools.description: Drop in a point lamp in lumens with real inverse-square falloff and soft shadows. Drag it anywhere.

tools.label: Spot
tools.description: Drop in a spotlight: lumens, cone angle and soft edge. Drag the lamp and its aim point.

tools.label: Edit Lights
tools.description: Select, drag, tune or delete the lights in this document.

tools.label: Show Lights
tools.description: Show or hide the light markers in the viewport.

tools.label: Materials
tools.description: Open the material library: colors, finishes and engineering data you can apply to bodies.

tools.label: AR Export
tools.description: Export GLB and USDZ, choose real or tabletop scale, and share to a phone on your Wi-Fi.

tools.label: Stop Sharing
tools.description: Stop serving the AR page to phones.

tools.label: Draft analysis
tools.description: Check pull-direction draft.

tools.label: Section analysis
tools.description: Inspect cavities and walls.

tools.label: Check geometry
tools.description: Check tooling geometry.

tools.label: Matte
tools.description: Flat, non-reflective surface.

tools.label: Satin
tools.description: Soft sheen, like painted or molded plastic.

tools.label: Glossy
tools.description: Hard, shiny highlights, like polished plastic or glass.

tools.label: Brushed metal
tools.description: Metal with a soft, broad reflection.

tools.label: Polished metal
tools.description: Mirror-like metal.

tools.label: Apply Material
tools.description: Give the highlighted material to the selected bodies: sets color, finish and density for mass.

tools.label: Remove Material
tools.description: Take the material off the selected bodies (their color stays).

tools.label: Find Assigned
tools.description: Jump the list to the material of the selected body.

tools.label: Compare
tools.description: Add the highlighted material to the side-by-side comparison (up to three).

tools.label: Clear Compare
tools.description: Empty the comparison table.

tools.label: Done
tools.description: Close the Materials tab and return to modeling.

tools.label: Select
tools.description: Select geometry and drag it. Points and curves move while every constraint stays satisfied.

tools.label: Gizmo
tools.description: Position and bind the gizmo; adjust its handles and snapping.

tools.label: Point
tools.description: Place a reference point on the active drawing plane of a 2D or 3D sketch.

tools.label: Axis
tools.description: Save the selected gizmo axis as a datum in a 2D or 3D sketch.

tools.label: Plane
tools.description: Save the current sketch datum plane.

tools.label: Save gizmo
tools.description: Save the current gizmo as a sketch datum.

tools.label: Project / Include
tools.description: Project edges or bodies, or intersect sketch curves with the active plane to create loft rail anchors. Choose As construction for references that stay out of profiles.

tools.label: To construction
tools.description: Turn the selected curves into reference (construction) geometry, or back into normal curves.

tools.label: Construction
tools.description: Construction mode (X): while it is pressed, new curves are reference geometry. Click again to go back to normal drawing.

tools.label: Line
tools.description: Draw connected lines, or lines from their midpoint (options bar). Horizontal and vertical lines are detected and constrained automatically.

tools.label: Rectangle
tools.description: Draw rectangles. Choose 2-point, center or rotated 3-point in the options bar.

tools.label: Ellipse
tools.description: Draw an ellipse. Choose center, 2-point (a box it fits in) or 3-point (long axis, then the other radius) in the options bar. Hold Shift (or press L) for a circle.

tools.label: Arc
tools.description: Draw arcs. Choose 3-point, center or tangent in the options bar.

tools.label: Polygon
tools.description: Draw regular polygons. Choose inscribed or circumscribed and the number of sides in the options bar.

tools.label: Slot
tools.description: A slot: two arc centers, then the width.

tools.label: Text
tools.description: Type words, pick a font and size, then click to place them as closed outlines you can extrude or emboss.

tools.label: Spline
tools.description: Draw splines through fit points or shaped by control points.

tools.label: Trim
tools.description: Cut a line, arc or circle back to the curves that cross it. Click the part to remove.

tools.label: Extend
tools.description: Lengthen a line or arc until it meets the next curve. Click near the end you want to extend.

tools.label: Offset
tools.description: Copy a curve (or a whole connected chain) a set distance to one side. Select curves (Shift-click adds), press Enter to finish selecting, then move to a side and click, or type the distance and press Enter.

tools.label: Fillet
tools.description: Round the corner where two lines meet. Type the radius, then click the two lines.

tools.label: Chamfer
tools.description: Cut the corner where two lines meet with a straight edge. Type the distance, then click the two lines.

tools.label: Mirror
tools.description: Mirror curves across a line. Pick the curves, press Enter, click the line. Live mode keeps both sides symmetric.

tools.label: Pattern
tools.description: Repeat sketch curves along a direction or around a center. Choose linear or circular in the options bar.

tools.label: Horizontal
tools.description: Make a line horizontal, or line two points up horizontally.

tools.label: Vertical
tools.description: Make a line vertical, or line two points up vertically.

tools.label: Coincident
tools.description: Join two points, or put a point on a curve.

tools.label: Parallel
tools.description: Make two lines parallel.

tools.label: Perpendicular
tools.description: Make two lines meet at 90°.

tools.label: Tangent
tools.description: Make a line and circle/arc (or two circles) touch smoothly.

tools.label: Equal
tools.description: Make two lines the same length, or two circles/arcs the same radius.

tools.label: Midpoint
tools.description: Put a point at the middle of a line.

tools.label: Concentric
tools.description: Give two circles/arcs the same center.

tools.label: Collinear
tools.description: Put two lines on the same infinite line.

tools.label: Symmetric
tools.description: Mirror two points across a line.

tools.label: Fix
tools.description: Lock a point or curve in place.

tools.label: Dimension
tools.description: Drive sizes with numbers: lengths, diameters, radii, distances, angles. Options: smart, horizontal, vertical.

tools.label: Curvature
tools.description: Curvature comb: hairs along splines, ellipses and arcs that show how sharply they bend. An even comb means a fair curve.

tools.label: Finish Sketch
tools.description: Keep the sketch and return to modeling.

tools.label: Cancel
tools.description: Discard the sketch.

tools.label: Section View
tools.description: Cut the model with a plane to look inside. Works in every view.

tools.label: Clear Section
tools.description: Remove the section cut.

tools.label: Front
tools.description: Look at the model from the front.

tools.label: Back
tools.description: Look at the model from the back.

tools.label: Left
tools.description: Look at the model from the left.

tools.label: Right
tools.description: Look at the model from the right.

tools.label: Top
tools.description: Look at the model from the top.

tools.label: Bottom
tools.description: Look at the model from the bottom.

tools.label: Isometric
tools.description: A three-quarter view.

tools.label: Look At
tools.description: Look straight at the selected plane, face or sketch.

tools.label: Zoom Extents
tools.description: Fit everything in the window.

tools.label: Orthographic
tools.description: No perspective: parallel projection.

tools.label: Perspective
tools.description: Natural perspective projection.

tools.label: Single
tools.description: One large view.

tools.label: Two Views
tools.description: The model view next to a locked Top view.

tools.label: Four Views
tools.description: Front, Right, Top and a free model view at once.

tools.label: Link Views
tools.description: Panning or zooming one view moves them all.

tools.label: Shaded
tools.description: Surfaces only.

tools.label: Shaded + edges
tools.description: Surfaces with edge lines.

tools.label: Wireframe
tools.description: Edges only.

tools.label: X-ray
tools.description: Toggle translucent faces in shaded styles to see geometry behind them. Wireframe already shows all edges without faces.

tools.label: Hide
tools.description: Hide the selected objects. Show All brings them back.

tools.label: Isolate
tools.description: Hide everything except the selected objects.

tools.label: Show All
tools.description: Show every hidden object.

tools.label: Grid
tools.description: Show the construction grid.

tools.label: Zebra stripes
tools.description: Reflection stripes for surface quality.
